name: Lucky Charm
description: Increases shiny rate of wild Pokemon near the owner

shinyMultiplier.label: Shiny Rate Multiplier
shinyMultiplier.tooltip:
Global multiplier on top of the proficiency-scaled shiny rate (base shiny = 1/8192).
§7Effective shiny rate per proficiency (multiplier × base):
§8  Prof 1: 1.4x × multiplier
§8  Prof 2: 1.8x × multiplier
§8  Prof 3: 2.2x × multiplier
§8  Prof 4: 2.6x × multiplier
§8  Prof 5: 3.0x × multiplier
